correctness.rationale: The five strict contractions have positive branch weights whose horizontal and vertical marginal sums equal the three interval lengths, giving uniform margins. The open set condition holds; Moran’s similarity formula and endpoint limits furnish each Hausdorff dimension strictly between 1 and 2. For every finite list of distinct parameters, repeated lower-left cylinder masses are exact powers (r−a)^k and yield a nonsingular Vandermonde matrix, proving continuum independence without infinite numerical extrapolation. The support K is compact, its measure concentration is weakly closed, and the signed measure inequality μ≥ημ0 is closed under weak limits by nonnegative continuous test functions. Every anchored family member lies in the closed convex witness, whose measures have exact support K; normalization at (1,1) preserves independence. value.rationale: The 2026 source explicitly isolates convex spaceability for copulas of fractal support as an unresolved strengthening of its maximal convex lineability theorem. The present construction settles that precise, mathematically motivated gap for every support Hausdorff dimension s in (1,2), replacing an unspecified topological obstruction by a compact closed convex family with continuum many linearly independent members. It supplies a reusable support-stabilization principle for singular dependence distributions; its value rests on a full structural theorem, not numeric novelty or code alone.
